data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of prior year reserves of GBP 5.6m in 2023. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 243.555m. The release was driven principally by favourable claims development in the Property portfolio, partially offset by adverse development in the Legal Indemnities class. No gross prior-year movement amount was explicitly stated in the technical movement notes, so the reported net movement (after reinsurance) has been used as the primary quantified measure.
raw_causal_phrases: a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column). The report explicitly states a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.6m; no explicit gross prior-year movement (gross of reinsurance) was provided. A gross claims development triangle is present but table extraction in the source text was fragmented; therefore the net figure has been used as a fallback for quantified prior-year movement. 'Legal Indemnities' has been mapped to 'Professional Lines' for LOB movement reporting (mapping assumption).
